description: Candidate component catalog for OneClickMC. Edition membership is defined here; per-version manifests record compatibility overrides. Downloadable entries are resolved live from the official Modrinth API for the exact Minecraft version and loader.

potato.name: Potato
potato.description: Performance comes first: optimization mods and lightweight visual touches. Shaders stay optional and off by default.
bullets: Prioritises performance and lower resource use
Smallest download of the three presets

balanced.name: Medium
balanced.description: The recommended default for typical PCs: optimization mods plus moderate, verified visual upgrades.
bullets: Moderate shaders and visual packs where verified

ultimate.name: I Paid for My Whole PC
ultimate.description: For powerful PCs: high-quality shaders, high-resolution packs and optional advanced visual features.
bullets: High-quality shader preset selected by default
Optional advanced features such as Distant Horizons

components.name: Sodium
components.summary: Modern rendering engine that reduces CPU and GPU overhead.

components.name: Lithium
components.summary: Game-logic and entity tick optimizations with no visual changes.

components.name: FerriteCore
components.summary: Reduces memory usage of block and model data.

components.name: ImmediatelyFast
components.summary: Batches immediate-mode rendering to cut draw-call overhead.

components.name: Entity Culling
components.summary: Skips rendering entities that are hidden behind geometry.

components.name: More Culling
components.summary: Adds extra block and item culling rules.

components.name: Dynamic FPS
components.summary: Lowers resource use while the game window is in the background.

components.name: ModernFix
components.summary: Startup and memory fixes. No Fabric build is published for the target versions.

components.name: Fabric API
components.summary: Required runtime library for most Fabric mods.

components.name: Iris Shaders
components.summary: Shader loader compatible with OptiFine shader packs.

components.name: Continuity
components.summary: Connected textures support for resource packs.

components.name: Not Enough Animations
components.summary: Adds third-person animations for common player actions.

components.name: 3D Skin Layers
components.summary: Renders the outer skin layer as real 3D geometry.

components.name: Eating Animation
components.summary: Animated eating and drinking. No Fabric build is published for the target versions.

components.name: Visuality
components.summary: Small particle effects such as block-hit sparks and slime trails.

components.name: Distant Horizons
components.summary: Adds level-of-detail terrain far beyond normal render distance.
caveats: Heavy on memory and storage; increase allocated RAM before enabling.
Shader integration depends on the shader pack; visual differences are expected.

components.name: Entity Model Features
components.summary: OptiFine-format entity model support, used by advanced resource packs.

components.name: Entity Texture Features
components.summary: OptiFine-format random and emissive entity textures.

components.name: Presence Footsteps
components.summary: Context-aware footstep sounds based on the block being walked on.

components.name: BSL Shaders
components.summary: Cinematic lighting, shadows, and water with several quality presets.

components.name: Sildur's Enhanced Default
components.summary: Modest visual upgrade that keeps the vanilla look.

components.name: Sildur's Basic Shaders
components.summary: Lightweight shader with basic shadows and water effects.

components.name: MakeUp — Ultra Fast
components.summary: Shader designed to stay inexpensive on low-end hardware.

components.name: Complementary Unbound
components.summary: Feature-rich shader with configurable quality profiles.

components.name: Bliss Shaders
components.summary: High-end shader focused on atmospheric lighting and volumetrics.
caveats: High visual load; expected to be heavy on integrated graphics.

components.name: Solas Shader
components.summary: Stylized color grading with soft shadows.

components.name: Derivative
components.summary: CurseForge-hosted shader. Not available through the verified Modrinth resolver.
caveats: Manual install only: download it yourself from the official CurseForge page.

components.name: Iteration T
components.summary: Candidate shader whose official project identity could not be confirmed.
caveats: No verified official download. OneClickMC will not install this shader.

components.name: Fresh Animations
components.summary: Expressive entity animations. Best with Entity Model Features and Entity Texture Features.

components.name: Stay True
components.summary: Vanilla-adjacent texture pack. Its Modrinth project could not be resolved at review time.
caveats: Unavailable through the official API on 2026-10-18; install manually if the project returns.

components.name: 3D Mace
components.summary: Adds a 3D model for the mace item.

components.name: Better Lanterns
components.summary: Improved lantern models and textures.

components.name: Motschen's Better Leaves
components.summary: Bushier leaf models with configurable styles.

components.name: Dark Mode Everywhere
components.summary: Dark UI textures. No matching file is published for the target versions.

components.name: Optimum Realism
components.summary: High-resolution, PBR-oriented realism textures.
caveats: Requires a large amount of VRAM; check the packet resolution before enabling.

components.name: PrettyRealistic PBR
components.summary: PBR resource pack designed for shader lighting.
caveats: Base texture packs in the same slot override each other; pick one.

components.name: Faithful 32x
components.summary: Doubled-resolution vanilla textures. Distributed on its own website.
caveats: Manual install only: download the correct edition from faithfulpack.net.

components.name: Vanilla Tweaks
components.summary: Build-your-own pack of small vanilla-style tweaks.
caveats: Packs are generated on the website for your selections; no direct file can be resolved.
